mapper.select: SELECT im.invoice_seq AS invoiceSeq , im.office_seq AS officeSeq , im.app_seq AS appSeq , im.invoice_category_code AS invCategoryCode , fn_get_cd_nm('BILL_DIV_CD', im.invoice_category_code) AS invCategoryName , im.invoice_content AS invContent , im.invoice_no AS invNo , to_char(im.create_at, 'YYYYMMDD') AS invDate , fn_get_cost_amount(im.office_seq, im.invoice_seq, 'govFee') AS govFee , fn_get_cost_amount(im.office_seq, im.invoice_seq, 'agencyFee') AS agencyFee , fn_get_cost_amount(im.office_seq, im.invoice_seq, 'vat') AS vat , fn_get_cost_amount(im.office_seq, im.invoice_seq, 'etcFee') AS etcFee , fn_get_cost_amount(im.office_seq, im.invoice_seq, 'transFee') AS transFee , fn_get_cost_amount(im.office_seq, im.invoice_seq, 'totalInvAmount') AS totalInvAmount , fn_get_cost_amount(im.office_seq, im.invoice_seq, 'depAmount') AS depAmount , fn_get_cost_amount(im.office_seq, im.invoice_seq, 'unpaidAmount') AS unpaidAmount , fn_get_cost_amount(im.office_seq, im.invoice_seq, 'abandonAmount') AS abandonAmount , im.create_at AS createAt , im.in_out_type AS inOutType FROM utb_invoice_mst im WHERE im.app_seq = #{tblSeq} AND im.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND im.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY im.create_at DESC
